metadata.title: The Completion, For Everyone: the whole theory in plain words
metadata.description:
The plain-language companion to The Completion (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21863521), written for readers with no physics background. Nothing in this document is new: every claim is the readable version of a claim made precisely in the technical paper, and every load-bearing number traces to a named, committed script in the public repository that re-derives it from scratch and exits non-zero if it stops being true.

It tells the whole story in order: why galaxies spin wrong; the dark-matter and MOND answers and the embarrassment each lives with; the coincidence at the center of this program -- that MOND's threshold acceleration a0 is, within a measured coefficient kappa = 0.551 +/- 0.043 consistent with one-half, exactly c sqrt(G rho_Lambda), the acceleration built from the dark-energy density; why a formula is not a theory and what a field theory is; the machine itself -- Aether-Scalar-Tensor (Skordis & Zlosnik 2021) with this program's factorised free function: a MOND kernel for galaxies, an offset-DBI sector whose floor is dark energy and whose excitation does the cosmological dark-matter job, and an a0-bump response for clusters, resonant at the MOND transition; the lensing pass (gamma_PPN = 1 exactly); the real CLASS-code CMB confrontation (acoustic peaks to 0.069%); the honest answer to "is there dark matter in this theory?" (no particle, no new substance, none in galaxies -- but the cosmological pressureless job is real, non-negotiable, and done by the same field); the three killed cluster mechanisms and the surviving candidate; the safety inspection (a no-ghost theorem, gravitational waves at exactly light speed, stability bounds that bit the program's own parameters); the price tag read aloud (five dark-sector numbers against LCDM's two); the registered kill-tests, led by the hash-stamped Gaia DR4 wide-binary target; the full list of non-claims, led by "kappa = 1/2 is not derived" and "this is not a theory of everything" (the 2026-06-23 retraction stands); and the one open problem, kappa^2 = 8 pi eps_tot.

AI-assisted research. Where this document simplifies, the technical paper governs.
